description.value: Clayburn Village Store is a heritage retail shop built in 1911 and painstakingly restored by its current owners since 1987, occupying a century-old building with original fir floors and a period tin-look ceiling in the historic Clayburn Village near Abbotsford. The store specialises in international and nostalgic candies alongside specialty European foods, and the owner bakes fresh scones, cornish pasties, sausage rolls, and quiche on-site each open morning. It offers touring cyclists a genuinely unhurried, step-back-in-time stop on Fraser Valley routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms this is a heritage candy and specialty food store at 34810 Clayburn Rd, Abbotsford, with fresh-baked goods (scones, cornish pasties, sausage rolls) and packaged candy sold to take away, supporting a Takeout value of true. No bike parking, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all three required criteria are null. OSM phone matches the website number; address was sourced from the website contact page as the OSM address field is empty.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, distinctive heritage food stop in the scenic Clayburn Village that offers real food value to Fraser Valley touring cyclists; seasonal closures are regular and well-documented, not a sign of closure.
